final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS c FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS s FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.k AS k, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / s2.s AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.s IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS av FROM s3) SELECT s3.k, s3.c, s3.r, s3.r - s4.av FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.r > s4.av
